description: This file defines classes and functions for building and serializing DOM trees, specifically for HTML/XML document manipulation, using the xml.dom.minidom implementation and custom wrappers.

classes.name: AttrList
classes.description: Wrapper class for element attributes providing dict-like access.

classes.name: NodeBuilder
classes.description: Wrapper class for DOM nodes, providing methods for DOM manipulation.

classes.name: TreeBuilder
classes.description: Class for constructing DOM documents and fragments, with methods for inserting elements, comments, doctype, and text.

methods.name: getDomBuilder
methods.description: Factory function that creates DOM builder classes and functions for DOM manipulation.

methods.name: testSerializer
methods.description: Serializes a DOM element into a string representation for debugging or inspection.
